properties.name: 1905 Kangra Earthquake Epicenter
properties.history: April 4, 1905: Most devastating earthquake in HP history. Over 20,000 deaths. Kangra town and Dharamshala were completely leveled.
properties.remarks: Region remains in high-risk Seismic Zone V.

properties.name: Mandi-Kullu Fault Zone
properties.remarks: Part of the Main Boundary Thrust (MBT). Active monitoring area.

properties.name: Kaurik Fault (Leo Pargial)
properties.history: 1975 Kinnaur Earthquake epicenter. Caused significant damage to monasteries and high-altitude villages.
properties.remarks: Fastest moving fault line in the region.
